_comment: Scene-generator object catalog (agentic_pipeline/scene_generator.py). Every entry is an IMPORTED pre-existing
object: 'kind' picks the centralized deformableManipulationTools builder, 'config' holds the
per-object physical parameters (constructor kwargs for that kind's config dataclass), 'dims'
is the tabletop footprint [m] used by the placement solver, 'source' is provenance, and
'inferred' lists any parameter NOT shipped by the source dataset, with how it was derived.
Masses for YCB objects are the official YCB paper values; RoboLab's mu=2.0 catalog frictions
are a documented grasp cheat and are replaced by realistic per-material values (params.py
Deformable material law: E = k_mu*(3*k_lambda+2*k_mu)/(k_lambda+k_mu), nu = k_lambda/(2*(k_lambda+k_mu));
k_damp = 0.02*k_mu (SOFT_BLOCK convention). DefGraspSim FEM anchors: rho=1000, nu=0.3, mu=0.7,

objects.name: green_tshirt
objects.description: Green knit T-shirt laid flat (RGBench measured fabric).
objects.source: RGBench (hwk0809/RGBench-Cloth-Sim2Real-v1, CC-BY 4.0) green_tshirt_5k.obj + measured params: area density 220 g/m^2, ground friction 0.266 (ASTM protocols)
inferred: scale=0.65 so the flat garment fits the 0.9x0.7 m worktop (fabric params are per-area, so the smaller garment stays physical)
stretch/bending stiffness kept at the PROVEN Newton-converted ClothConfig values; RGBench solver-native stiffness (stretch 230000) is not unit-transplantable

objects.name: blue_dress
objects.description: Blue dress laid flat (RGBench measured fabric, stiffer weave than the tshirt).
objects.source: RGBench blue_dress 20k mesh (decimated to 6k faces) + measured params: area density 194 g/m^2, friction 0.266
inferred: scale=0.6 to fit the worktop
tri_ke/tri_ka = 10 * (900000/230000) ~ 39: RGBench stretch RATIO dress/tshirt applied to the proven tshirt tri_ke (units not transplantable, ratios are)
edge_ke = 5e-5 * (850/1000): same relative scaling for bending

objects.name: power_cable
objects.description: Black jacketed power cable, ~0.5 m, 16 mm diameter.
objects.source: canonical CABLE (this repo; NVIDIA-recipe capsule rod, the representation NVIDIA itself uses for ropes)

objects.name: nylon_rope
objects.description: Braided nylon rope segment, ~0.5 m, 9.5 mm diameter (softer and lighter than the power cable).
objects.source: YCB object 67 rope PHYSICAL specs (81 g / 3 m, braided; no 3D scan exists) mapped onto the CableConfig rod schema
inferred: radius=4.75 mm and volume density 380 kg/m^3 from the YCB 81 g / 3 m spec assuming ~9.5 mm braid diameter
bend_stiffness 5 (vs 15 jacketed cable): a braid bends much easier than a jacketed conductor
friction 0.5 nylon-on-wood; contact ke/kd kept at the proven cable values

objects.name: sponge
objects.description: Yellow scrub sponge (very soft, light, 11x8x2 cm).
objects.source: YCB 026_sponge google_16k scan (CC-BY 4.0), tetrahedralized offline (assets/objects/_utils/make_tet.py, DefGraspSim .tet convention)
inferred: density=54 kg/m^3 = official YCB mass 6.2 g / scan volume
E=2e4 Pa (DefGraspSim's softest sweep anchor; cellulose sponge literature 20-50 kPa), nu=0.3 (DefGraspSim uniform) -> k_mu=7.7e3, k_lambda=1.15e4
k_damp=0.02*k_mu (SOFT_BLOCK convention)
mu=0.8 porous/abrasive surface

soft_contact_ke/kd/kf re-derived from PER-PARTICLE MASS of the fTetWild mesh (ke = 2.5e4*(m_p/9e-4 kg) keeps the pair at the SOFT_BLOCK eta operating point; kd from pair critical damping ~1.5x crit; kf = 0.01*ke)

objects.name: foam_brick

objects.source: YCB 061_foam_brick google_16k scan (CC-BY 4.0), tetrahedralized offline
inferred: density=149 kg/m^3 = official YCB mass 28 g / scan volume
E=1e5 Pa firm EVA foam (inside DefGraspSim's skin-to-plastic sweep), nu=0.3 -> k_mu=3.85e4, k_lambda=5.77e4
k_damp=0.02*k_mu
mu=0.7 rubbery foam

soft_contact_ke/kd/kf re-derived from PER-PARTICLE MASS of the fTetWild mesh (ke = 2.5e4*(m_p/9e-4 kg) keeps the pair at the SOFT_BLOCK eta operating point; kd from pair critical damping ~1.5x crit; kf = 0.01*ke)

objects.name: banana_soft
objects.description: Deformable ripe banana (DefGraspSim-parameterized FEM version of the YCB banana).
objects.source: YCB 011_banana google_16k scan tetrahedralized offline; FEM parameters are DefGraspSim's OFFICIAL settings (their banana IS the YCB banana; mesh distribution is Google-Drive-gated so the geometry was rebuilt from YCB with their own mesh->tet pipeline)
inferred: E=2e5 Pa chosen from DefGraspSim's documented sweep {2e4,2e5,2e6,2e9} as the produce-like tier; rho=1000, nu=0.3, mu=0.7 are DefGraspSim's uniform official values
k_damp=0.02*k_mu

soft_contact_ke/kd/kf re-derived from PER-PARTICLE MASS of the fTetWild mesh (ke = 2.5e4*(m_p/9e-4 kg) keeps the pair at the SOFT_BLOCK eta operating point; kd from pair critical damping ~1.5x crit; kf = 0.01*ke)
